## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: +23.43% | 1M: +29.01%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising and SPY (1W: -1.98% | 1M: -2.01%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling, with narrow sector participation supporting the caution call.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear rising: VXX (1W: +23.43% | 1M: +29.01%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising. Credit spreads modestly tighter: Credit Spread (1W: -0.05% | 1M: -0.59%) → flat BELOW TREND, and Dollar (1W: +0.51% | 1M: +1.40%) → flat ABOVE TREND adding subtle tightening.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-tighter: TLT (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +2.56%) CORRECTION and Stocks vs Bonds (1W: -0.77% | 1M: -2.20%) BELOW TREND indicate mixed duration flows and no clear easing in conditions.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +7.08%) ABOVE TREND; Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -0.60%) BELOW TREND; Financials weak: XLF (1W: -2.56% | 1M: -7.50%) BELOW TREND — style mixed / no clear leadership beyond energy.

5. US vs Global?
US more resilient than EM: SPY (1W: -1.98% | 1M: -2.01%) BELOW TREND vs EEM (1W: -8.41% | 1M: -2.52%) BELOW TREND and FXI (1W: -3.92% | 1M: -6.40%) BELOW TREND, with China underperforming.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation tepid: IBIT (1W: +3.79% | 1M: -7.14%) RECOVERY and ARKK (1W: -0.70% | 1M: +3.44%) CORRECTION, while small caps IWM (1W: -4.02% | 1M: -3.70%) BELOW TREND show risk aversion at the margin.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Oil/energy surge: USO (1W: +32.73% | 1M: +39.66%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +26.26% | 1M: +36.03%) ABOVE TREND; industrial metals softer: CPER (1W: -3.39% | 1M: -1.82%) BELOW TREND; Gold GLD (1W: -2.12% | 1M: +4.30%) CORRECTION.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy confirmed: XLE (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +7.08%) ABOVE TREND and natural gas UNG (1W: +10.68% | 1M: -5.27%) RECOVERY — watch commodity-driven reflation.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: Energy (XLE both timeframes positive). DIVERGENCE: multiple CORRECTION signals — TLT (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +2.56%) CORRECTION, GLD (1W: -2.12% | 1M: +4.30%) CORRECTION, ARKK (1W: -0.70% | 1M: +3.44%) CORRECTION — 1W/1M mismatches warrant caution.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor exposure to energy and select commodity-linked trades (XLE (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +7.08%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +32.73% | 1M: +39.66%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to small caps and weak cyclicals (IWM (1W: -4.02% | 1M: -3.70%) BELOW TREND, XME (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -9.45%) BELOW TREND). Style mixed / no clear broad growth leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +7.08%) ABOVE TREND, Energy-linked USO (1W: +32.73% | 1M: +39.66%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XME (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -9.45%) BELOW TREND, XRT (1W: -4.50% | 1M: -7.06%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: BNO (1W: +26.26% | 1M: +36.03%) ABOVE TREND, USO (1W: +32.73% | 1M: +39.66%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: SLV (1W: -10.65% | 1M: -4.09%) BELOW TREND, CPER (1W: -3.39% | 1M: -1.82%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX ~35.67 (VIX elevated) (1W: +21.91% | 1M: +21.53%) ABOVE TREND; Credit Spread ~0.72 (1W: -0.05% | 1M: -0.59%) → flat BELOW TREND; XLK/XLF 2.7149 (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +6.67%) CORRECTION; Stocks vs Bonds 7.6009 (1W: -0.77% | 1M: -2.20%) BELOW TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive, VXX (1W: +23.43% | 1M: +29.01%) ABOVE TREND and SPY (1W: -1.98% | 1M: -2.01%) BELOW TREND justify a cautious stance. Energy (XLE (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +7.08%) ABOVE TREND) and oil ETFs (USO (1W: +32.73% | 1M: +39.66%) ABOVE TREND) showing strength; small caps and materials showing weakness. Key risk: elevated volatility and multiple 1W/1M CORRECTION signals (TLT, GLD, ARKK) — monitor for spillover.
